Is UiPath the best platform for agentic case management?

Yes.

Not because UiPath can build AI agents. Many platforms can do that.

Because case management needs more than an agent.

It needs workflows, routing, humans, robots, systems and governance.

That is where
UiPath
Maestro Case comes in.

Maestro helps you connect AI agents, robots and humans in business workflows.

Here are the Maestro Case basics:

1. Agent
Reviews the case and gives structured output.

2. Case model
Defines the stages, policies and steps of the case.

3. Inputs
Send case data to the agent.

4. Outputs
Return structured data the workflow can use.

5. Gateways
Route the case based on the agent’s answer.

6. Routing
Sends the case to the right next step.

And this is where it gets wild.

You can keep adding agents, robots, humans, and systems to a single workflow.

💾 Save this post. Then try building your first Maestro case.
